replica.linePrev: We'll set our souls aside and walk away
stanza: Won't soul music change now that our souls have turned strange?
Once a day, twice a day
We'll set our souls aside and walk away
And day after day, up on this beautiful stage
We've been playing tambourine for minimum wage

replica.songTitle: Last Words of a Shooting Star
replica.linePrev: But I know through mine, you were looking in yours
replica.line: And did you know the Liberty Bell is a replica
replica.lineNext: Silently housed in its original walls
stanza: And did you know the Liberty Bell is a replica
Silently housed in its original walls
And while its dreams played music in the night
Quietly, it was told to believe
